provenance.construction: Kasai affine 2BGA: a two-block group-algebra code over the affine group Aff(F_q) in its metacyclic realization Z_q x| Z_{q-1} (order q(q-1); 342 for q=19, 272 for q=17). With research/kit/group_algebra.py: mul, _ = metacyclic(q, q-1, r) where r is the smallest primitive root mod q, then HX, HZ = build_2bga(mul, a, b) for the two exponent sets a, b recorded in the reproduction section.
